title: Drone attack on Iraq gas complex causes power outages
text:
Drone attack on Iraq gas complex causes power outages | South China Morning Post Middle East - Middle East Drone attack on Iraq gas complex causes power outages Advertisement Middle East World Middle East Drone attack on Iraq gas complex causes power outages 
 Strike damages UAE-owned Khor Mor site as authorities scramble to protect Kurdistan’s electricity grid
 1 -MIN READ 1 -MIN Listen Agence France-Presse Published: 6:09am, 9 Nov 2026 Updated: 11:48am, 9 Nov 2026 An Emirati-owned gas complex in Iraq’s autonomous Kurdistan region was attacked on Sunday, disrupting the gas supply to the region’s power plants, local Kurdish authorities said.
 “At 11pm (2000 GMT), the Khor Mor gas field came under a terrorist attack,” the regional natural resources and electricity authorities said in a statement, without elaborating.
 A Kurdish security source told Agence France-Presse that an “explosive-laden drone” hit the field.
